LESSON: PRESENTATION SKILLS SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.5: Presentation skills SPEAKING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Presentation skills SPEAKING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. relate various community activities in order in which they occur
2. use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self- confidently
3. recall ideas on the themes in a logical manner Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and Collaboration: learners practice speaking before their peers Critical thinking and problem solving: learners organize their presentations

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. relate various community activities in order in which they occur
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to relate various community activities in order in which they occur. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self- confidently
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self- confidently. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. recall ideas on the themes in a logical manner Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and Collaboration: learners practice speaking before their peers Critical thinking and problem solving: learners organize their presentations
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recall ideas on the themes in a logical manner Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and Collaboration: learners practice speaking before their peers Critical thinking and problem solving: learners organize their presentations. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Presentation skills SPEAKING.
2. Explain Presentation skills SPEAKING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Presentation skills SPEAKING.
4. Show that you can: relate various community activities in order in which they occur
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Presentation skills SPEAKING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Presentation skills SPEAKING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. relate various community activities in order in which they occur
2. use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self- confidently
3. recall ideas on the themes in a logical manner Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and Collaboration: learners practice speaking before their peers Critical thinking and problem solving: learners organize their presentations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
